items.title: Nasdaq (NDAQ) Ends Miami Case And Sells Fund Secondaries Business
items.summary: NasdaqGS:NDAQ has resolved its nearly decade-long litigation with Miami International Holdings, with all claims and counterclaims dismissed. Nasdaq is selling its fund secondaries business to its former affiliate, Nasdaq Private Market, reshaping its private markets footprint. For investors tracking Nasdaq, these moves come as the stock trades around $90.42, with a 9.6% gain over the past 30 days but a decline of 6.5% year to date.
